title: Snowflake Villa | KEY.co
description_expanded: Spanning three levels, the villa blends modern mountain décor with cozy, family-friendly living. Vaulted ceilings, skylights, and a marble-surround fireplace bring warmth to the great room, while the chef’s kitchen with Thermador appliances invites evenings of home-cooked meals and lively conversation. After a day on the slopes, unwind in the bubbling hot tub, enjoy a movie night on the 110” projector screen, or take in the cool mountain air from one of the home’s balconies. With thoughtful touches like a heated garage, full en-suite bathrooms in every bedroom, and quick access to Park City’s dining, shopping, and outdoor thrills—Snowflake Villa is a perfectly appointed base for your next mountain getaway. Just one block from Park City’s vibrant Main Street and steps from ski-in/ski-out access via the Town Lift, Snowflake Villa offers a luxurious mountain escape with style and comfort. This three-bedroom, four-bathroom retreat is designed to host up to eight guests with ease, featuring a private hot tub, gas fireplaces, and a dedicated home theatre. Whether it’s a bluebird ski day or a summer afternoon spent exploring the nearby trails, the home’s unbeatable location and inviting design set the stage for unforgettable alpine adventures.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 3 - Third Floor: Double Over Double Bunk

Features: Parking in the driveway and heated 1-car garage.
